name: Corporate Action 2
definition: Provides information about the CA event.

EventStage.name: Event Stage
EventStage.definition: Stage in the corporate action event life cycle.

DefaultOptionType.name: Default Option Type
DefaultOptionType.definition: Identifies the option that will be selected by default if no instruction is provided by account owner.

DefaultOptionNumber.name: Default Option Number
DefaultOptionNumber.definition: Identifies the option number that will be selected by default if no instruction is provided by account owner.

CalculationMethod.name: Calculation Method
CalculationMethod.definition: The method of calculation of drawings and partial redemptions.

BackEndOddLotSecuritiesQuantity.name: Back End Odd Lot Securities Quantity
BackEndOddLotSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Represents the presence of a back end odd lot provision and the quantity of equity required after proration to be eligible for this privilege.

FrontEndOddLotSecuritiesQuantity.name: Front End Odd Lot Securities Quantity
FrontEndOddLotSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Specifies that if an order is prorated holders of odd lots who tender their full position will not have tendered position prorated but rather accepted in full.

MinimumExercisableSecuritiesQuantity.name: Minimum Exercisable Securities Quantity
MinimumExercisableSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Minimum quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

MinimumExercisableMultipleSecuritiesQuan.name: Minimum Exercisable Multiple Securities Quantity
MinimumExercisableMultipleSecuritiesQuan.definition: Minimum multiple quantity of financial instrument or lot of rights/warrants that must be exercised.

IncrementalDenomination.name: Incremental Denomination
IncrementalDenomination.definition: Amount used when the called amount is not met by running the lottery with the base denomination.

NewDenominationSecuritiesQuantity.name: New Denomination Securities Quantity
NewDenominationSecuritiesQuantity.definition: New Denomination of the equity following, eg, an increase or decrease in nominal value.

NewBoardLotSecuritiesQuantity.name: New Board Lot Securities Quantity
NewBoardLotSecuritiesQuantity.definition: Quantity of equity that makes up the new board lot.

SecuritiesQuantitySought.name: Securities Quantity Sought
SecuritiesQuantitySought.definition: Quantity of securities the offeror/issuer will purchase or redeem under the terms of the event. This can be a number or the term "any and all".

BaseDenomination.name: Base Denomination
BaseDenomination.definition: The minimum integral amount of securities that each account owner must have remaining after the called amounts are applied.

ChangeType.name: Change Type
ChangeType.definition: Specifies the type of change announced.

OfferType.name: Offer Type
OfferType.definition: Specifies the conditions that apply to the offer.

RestrictionIndicator.name: Restriction Indicator
RestrictionIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is restrictions apply to the CA event or not.||Yes = There is restrictions.|No = There is no restrictions.

PartialElectionIndicator.name: Partial Election Indicator
PartialElectionIndicator.definition: Specifies if the issuer will allow the agent to accept partial elections. It is to allow split voting over options. It allows the client to elect more than one option to be selected per designated holding.

ElectionType.name: Election Type
ElectionType.definition: Specifies the effect on the holdings of electing a Corporate Action option.

LotteryType.name: Lottery Type
LotteryType.definition: Specifies the type of lottery announced.

IncomeType.name: Income Type
IncomeType.definition: Specifies the type of income.|The lists of income type codes to be used, are available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

DividendType.name: Dividend Type
DividendType.definition: Specifies the conditions in which a dividend is paid.

IntermediateSecuritiesDistributionType.name: Intermediate Securities Distribution Type
IntermediateSecuritiesDistributionType.definition: Type of intermediates securities distribution, eg, stock dividend, reverse right.

CouponNumber.name: Coupon Number
CouponNumber.definition: Number of the coupon attached/associated with a security.

InterestAccruedNumberOfDays.name: Interest Accrued Number Of Days
InterestAccruedNumberOfDays.definition: Number of days used for calculating the accrued interest amount.

NewDenominationCurrency.name: New Denomination Currency
NewDenominationCurrency.definition: New denomination currency of the inancial instrument.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to a CA event.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to a CA event.

PeriodDetails.name: Period Details
PeriodDetails.definition: Provides information about the periods related to a CA event.

RateAndAmountDetails.name: Rate And Amount Details
RateAndAmountDetails.definition: Provides information about rates and amounts related to a CA event.

CertificationRequiredIndicator.name: Certification Required Indicator
CertificationRequiredIndicator.definition: Indicates whether certification is required from the account owner.

CertificationType.name: Certification Type
CertificationType.definition: Type of certification which is required.

CapitalGain.name: Capital Gain
CapitalGain.definition: Specifies whether the capital gain is in the scope of the EU Savings directive for the income realised upon the sale, refund or redemption of shares and units (.) (Article 6(1d)).

TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.name: Taxable Income Per Share Calculated
TaxableIncomePerShareCalculated.definition: Specifies whether the financial instrument calculates the taxable income per dividend/taxable income per share.

RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.name: Renounceable Entitlement Status Type
RenounceableEntitlementStatusType.definition: Specifies whether terms of the event allow resale of the rights.

ConversionType.name: Conversion Type
ConversionType.definition: Specifies the conversion type of an instrument.

DistributionType.name: Distribution Type
DistributionType.definition: Specifies whether the proceeds of the event will be distributed on a rolling basis rather than on a specific date.
